surface_divergence_closed_form — DRIVE tactorque op

• Data kinds: matrix × scalar × scalar → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.surface_divergence_closed_form(p, G: 'float', nu: 'float') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import tactorque; tactorque.surface_divergence_closed_form(p, G: 'float', nu: 'float') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("surface_divergence_closed_form"))

Usage

Closed form of the divergence of the tangential surface displacement of a half-space, ∇·ū = −(1−2ν) p/(2G) (derived in this module from the Boussinesq point load ū_r = −(1−2ν)P/(4πGr) and, in 2-D, ∇·(r̂/r) = 2πδ²). Gate comparing it with the numerical divergence of the convolution (0.2 % for r < 0.8a, measured). Raises ValueError: G ≤ 0.
